name: API: falsely ignore payroll permission by group
text_content:
based on YY testing for yearly report she found v1.2 did not follow payroll permisson by groups

Setup (staging): company with payroll permission by group turned on.

Admin YYD (2n1wm@belgianairways.com): payroll admin for everyone
Danny (stgyyddanny@yopmail.com): payroll admin for one group

Current behavior:

Danny sees payroll data for every employee in the company, across the whole new payroll module (Yearly Report, BIK, forms, contribution reports). The v1.2 endpoints return all employees no matter who calls them, e.g.:

GET /api/v1.2/payroll/summary/individuals?from&to
GET /api/v1.2/payroll/summary/individuals/{id}?from&to
GET /api/v1.2/payroll/summary/monthly?year
GET /api/v1.2/payroll/bik and /api/v1.2/payroll/bik/{employee_id}
GET /api/v1.2/payroll/form/ea, /api/v1.2/payroll/form/pcb2/..., /api/v1.2/payroll/contribution/...

Expected behavior (same as legacy):

A payroll admin assigned to a group sees only the employees in their group, on every payroll endpoint.
Requesting an employee outside the group (e.g. summary/individuals/{id}) is rejected.
A payroll admin for everyone still sees all employees.
